pricing.rate_source: fal.ai list prices, re-verified live 2026-11-28 from https://fal.ai/learn/tools/kling-3-0-pro-vs-sora-2-pro (comparison table: per-second price with elements $0.224 audio off, $0.336 audio on; base $0.112 audio off, $0.168 audio on, $0.196 voice control) and https://fal.ai/learn/tools/seedance-2-0-vs-kling-3-0 (image-to-video with elements $0.224/second audio off, $0.336/second audio on, $0.392/second voice control; text-to-video and image-to-video without elements $0.112/second audio off, $0.168/second audio on, $0.196/second voice control). The base $0.112/s rate applies ONLY WITHOUT elements. The official API schema page https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/image-to-video/api lists no pricing. This round uses audio OFF with elements: every shot carries the Nadia character element (@Element1).

keyframe_generation_cost.basis: Keyframes and character references are generated with the platform built-in image generation, which is not a billed provider charge in this environment. Recorded as $0 billed / not-applicable rather than an invented number. No keyframe or reference has been generated yet: all are pending script approval.

retry_budget.rule: One retry per failed shot, at that shot's own cost ($1.344 per 6 s shot). A retry is a new paid generation; a failed generation may still be charged if GPU time was spent (provider-documented 422 behaviour).
retry_budget.worst_case_note: Worst case = every shot fails once and succeeds on its one retry: $10.752 + $10.752 = $21.504, rounded $21.50. No second retry is budgeted without a new approval.

other_charges.taxes_fees: UNCONFIRMED — no tax or fee is stated on the pricing page read.
other_charges.upload_storage: No upload or storage charge is stated for this endpoint's pricing; outputs are downloaded to the delivery folder. UNCONFIRMED as a separate line item — none is listed on the pricing page read.

supersedes: The R2 draft estimate of 8 clips x 6 s x $0.168/s = $8.06 (audio ON, without elements) and the preflight estimate of 8 clips x 6 s x $0.112/s = $5.38 (audio OFF, without elements) are BOTH SUPERSEDED by this plan: same 8 clips and 48 s, audio OFF, WITH elements, $10.75. The counts are unchanged; the rate changed. Reason: the elements pricing tier was missed — fal.ai charges a separate, higher tier for image-to-video with elements ($0.224/s audio off), and every shot in this production uses the Nadia character element (DEMO-CHAR-002, all 8 shots per character-appearance-map.json).
disclaimer: Estimate only, not a guaranteed final bill. The provider charges at generation time from prepaid credits; a failed generation after GPU time may still cost up to its clip price, and server errors (HTTP 500+) are never charged.
